<script>
	var Loop = {

		data: null,
		status: null,
		tempVariant: null,
		tempInput: null,
		elements: null,
		config: {
			productMode: null,
			variantParam: 'variant',
			targets: {
				url: null,
				input: null,
				options: null,
				attr: null,
				atc: null
			}
		},
		investigator: {
			count: 0
		},

		//PUBLIC FUNCTIONS-----------------------------------------
	    //---------------------------------------------------------

	    //The bread and butter of interactions
	    setup: function(productMode){
	    	//Product Modes*** STRING
	    	//-url
	    	//-input 
	    	//-options
	    	if(productMode === undefined){
	    		//check to see if product mode is config'd
	    		if(this.config.productMode === undefined || this.config.productMode === null){
	    			this._throwError(['Setup Product Mode is undefined.', 'Please look at the Loop Docs to learn how to configure your Product Mode']);
	    			return false;
	    		}
	    		productMode = this.config.productMode;
	    	}

	    	this.config.productMode = productMode;


	    	switch(productMode){
	    		case 'url':
	    			//grab what should be the default variant
	    			

	    			if(Loop.getParams(Loop.config.variantParam)){
	    				this.tempVariant = Loop.getParams(Loop.config.variantParam);
	    			}
	    			this.bindElements();
	    			break;

	    		case 'input':
	    			var input;
	    			if(this.config.targets.input === null){
	    				this._throwError(['Input Element not defined.','Check out our docs to learn how to configure your Loop Settings']);
	    				return false;
	    			}
	    			input = document.querySelectorAll(this.config.targets.input);
	    			if(input.length == 1){
	    				this.bindElements(input);
	    			}else if(input.length == 0){
	    				this._throwError(['Could not find any elements with selector "' + this.config.targets.input +'"', "Double check to make sure 'Loop.config.targets.input' is pointed at the right selector."]);
	    				return false;
	    			}else if(input.length > 1){
	    				this._throwError(['Found multiple elements with selector "' + this.config.targets.input +'"', "Please make sure you are targeting a single input containing the selcted variant id as it's value"]);
	    				return false;
	    			}
	    			break;

	    		case 'options':
	    			var input;
	    			if(this.config.targets.options === null){
	    				this._throwError(['Input Element not defined.','Check out our docs to learn how to configure your Loop Settings']);
	    				return false;
	    			}
	    			input = document.querySelectorAll(this.config.targets.options);
	    			if(input.length == 0){
	    				this._throwError(['Could not find any elements with selector "' + this.config.targets.input +'"', "Double check to make sure 'Loop.config.targets.input' is pointed at the right selector."]);
	    				return false;
	    			}else{
	    				this.bindElements(input);
	    			}
	    			break;
	    		default:
	    			this._throwError(['Error in setup function', 'Check to make sure your configs and/or setup mode are configured correctly']);
	    			break;
	    	}
	    },
	    //used to watch for changes on the PDP
	    //inputs - required, array, binds with options or hidden input
	    //atc - optional, element, binds click event and stops cart
	    bindElements: function(inputs, atc){
	    	if(this.config.productMode === 'input'){
	    		inputs.forEach(function(element){
		   			element.addEventListener('change', function(){
		   				console.log(this.value);
		   			});
	   			});
	    	}
	   		if(atc === undefined){
	   			if(this.config.targets.atc){
	   				atc = document.querySelector(this.config.targets.atc);
	   			} else {
	   				return false;
	   			}
	   		}
	   		atc.addEventListener('click', function(event){
	   			event.preventDefault();
	   			event.stopImmediatePropagation();
	   			Loop.submit(undefined);
	   		});	
	    },
	    //Uses Loop API to create cart
	    //variant - required, string, variant id
	    //callback - optional 
		addToCart: function(variant, callback){
			if(variant === undefined){
				if(this.tempVariant != undefined){
					variant = this.tempVariant;
				} else {
					if(this.config.productMode === 'url'){
						console.log(Loop.getParams(Loop.config.variantParam));
						var paramVar = Loop.getParams(Loop.config.variantParam);
						if(paramVar != false){
							variant = paramVar;
						} else {
							this._throwError('No variant found, check your config');
							return false;
						}
					}else{
						this._throwError('No variant found, check your config');
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			this.data.cart = variant;
			var payload = {
				cart: variant
			};
			this._requestMachine('POST', 'https://api.loopreturns.com/api/v1/cart/', payload, function(response){
				Loop.data.token = response.token;
				if(callback != undefined){
					console.dir(response);
					callback(response);
				}
			});
		},
		submit: function(variant){
			if(variant === undefined){
				if(this.tempVariant != undefined){
					variant = this.tempVariant;
				}
				if(this.config.productMode === 'url'){
					var paramVar = Loop.getParams(Loop.config.variantParam);
					if(paramVar != false){
						variant = paramVar;
					}
				}
				if(variant === undefined){
					this._throwError('No variant found, check your config');
					return false;
				}
			}
			this.data.cart = variant;
			var payload = {
				cart: variant
			};
			this._requestMachine('POST', 'https://api.loopreturns.com/api/v1/cart/', payload, function(response){
				console.log(response)
				Loop.data.token = response.token;
				Loop.goBack();
			});
		},
		//update the temp variant
		updateVariant: function(variant, callback){
			if(variant === undefined){
				this._throwError('updateVariant is recieving an undefined variant and cannot update');
				return false;
			}
			this.tempVariant = variant;
			if(callback != undefined){
				callback(tempVariant);
			}
		},
		//Dynamic "back to app" function
		goBack: function(){
	    	Loop.storage.kill('Loop_data');
	    	if(this.data.token != undefined){
	    		console.log(this.data)
		    	window.location.href = "http://" + this.data.loop_domain + "/#/cart/" + this.data.token;
		    }else{
		    	window.location.href = 'http://' + this.data.loop_redirect_url;
	    	} 
	    },
	    //Attach api key and save it
	    setKey: function(key, callback){
	    	if(key === undefined){
				this._throwError('Function not being passed Loop API key');
				return false;
			}
	    	this.data.apiKey = key;
	    	this.storage.set('Loop_data', this.data);
	    	if(callback != undefined){
				callback();
			}
	    },
	    //URL decoder
		getParams: function(param){
			var result = {};
			window.location.search.substr(1).split("&").forEach(function(item){
				var tmp = item.split("=");
				result[tmp[0]] = decodeURIComponent(tmp[1]);
			});
			if(param != undefined){
				if(result[param]){
					return result[param];
				}
				this._throwError('No Params found with keyword: ' + param);
				return false;
			}
			return result;
		},
		//local storage communication
		storage: {
			get: function(storeName){
				return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storeName) || null);
			},
			set: function(storeName, storeData){
				localStorage.setItem(storeName, JSON.stringify(storeData));
			},
			kill: function(storeName){
				localStorage.removeItem(storeName);
			}
		},
		//Binds to variant input often found on PDP
		attachListener: function(id){
			var foundElements = document.querySelectorAll(id);
			if(foundElements.length >= 1){
				foundElements.forEach(function(selector){
					selector.addEventListener('change',function(){
		      			console.log('Variant Changed to: ' + selector);
		        		Loop.tempVariant = document.querySelector(id).value;
		      		});
				});
		    } else {
		    	this._throwError('Cannot find selectors to attach to');
		    }
		},

		interigate: function(target){
			if(target.id != ""){
				return target.id;
   			}else{
   				console.log('No ID on objecting, checking classes');
   				console.log(target.classList);
   				if(target.classList > 0){
   					return target.classList;
   				} else {
   					return Loop.interigate(target.parentElement);
   				}
   			}
		},

		investigate: function(){
			//this requires JQuery unfortunately
			$('body').append('<div id="LRS__investigation-block"><div class="LRS__investigation-block__close"><img src="https://admin.loopreturns.com/img/icons/close.svg"></div><div class="LRS__investigation-block__header"><div class="LRS__investigation-block__img"><img src="https://admin.loopreturns.com/img/LoopLogo_small.png"></div></div><div class="LRS__investigation-block__info"><p>Click the "Add To Cart" Button</p></div></div>');
			document.addEventListener('click', function(event){
				console.log(event);
				Loop.investigator.count++;
				if(Loop.investigator.count > 3){
					firstElem = document.querySelector('.LRS__investigation-block__item');
					firstElem.parentNode.removeChild(firstElem);
				}
				event.preventDefault();
	   			event.stopImmediatePropagation();
	   			var targetSelector = Loop.interigate(event.target);
	   			
				$('#LRS__investigation-block').append('<div class="LRS__investigation-block__item">' + targetSelector + '</div>');
			});
		},

	    //ENCAPSULATED FUNCTIONS-----------------------------------
	    //---------------------------------------------------------

	   	//Vanilla AJAX requests
		_requestMachine: function(type, href, payload, callback){
			var data = null;

			if(payload != undefined){
				data = JSON.stringify(payload);
			}

			var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
			xhr.withCredentials = true;

			xhr.addEventListener("readystatechange", function () {
				if (this.readyState === this.DONE) {
				    callback(JSON.parse(this.responseText));
				}
			});

			xhr.open(type, href);
			xhr.setRequestHeader("x-authorization", this.data.apiKey);
			xhr.setRequestHeader("content-type", "application/json");
			xhr.send(data);
		},
	   	//Find global returns bar elements
		_scopeElements: function(){
			this.elements = {
				amount: document.getElementById('LRS-amount'),
				link: document.getElementById('LRS-link'),
				LRS: document.getElementById('LRS')
			};
			
		},
	   	//Renders information to the global returns bar
		_render: function(){
			var that = this;
			document.body.classList.add('loop-returns-activated');
			if(this.data.loop_total != undefined){
				this.elements.amount.innerHTML = this._moneyFilter(that.data.loop_total);
			}else{
				this._throwError(['Cannot find Data on render()'])
			}
		},
	   	//Turn ints into cold hard cash
		_moneyFilter: function(value){
	        if(value !== undefined){
				value = value.toString();
				if(value.length === 1){
					var firstHalf = '0';
					var secondHalf = '0' + value;
				} else if(value.length === 2){
					var firstHalf = '0';
					var secondHalf = value;

				} else {
					var firstHalf = value.slice(0,(value.length - 2));
					var secondHalf = value.substring(value.length, (value.length - 2));
				}

			return '$' + firstHalf + '.' + secondHalf;

			} else {
				return '$' + value;
			}
	    },
	    //Error control function
	    _throwError: function(error){
	    	console.log('[LOOP ERROR]----------------------------');
	    	if(typeof error === 'string'){
	    		console.log(error);
	    	}else if(Array.isArray(error)){
	    		error.forEach(function(error){
	    			console.log(error);
	    		});
	    	}else{
	    		console.log('Undefined Error');
	    	}
	    },
	    //Initialize Loop on the store
		_init: function(){
			//Check URL to see if user is coming from Loop Returns
			if(window.location.href.indexOf('loop_total') > -1){
				this.storage.set('Loop_data', this.getParams());
				window.history.replaceState({}, 'delete', '/');
			}
			//Check data storage to see if they are still in the middle of a return flow
			this.data = this.storage.get('Loop_data');
			if(this.data != null){
				this.status = 'active';
				this._scopeElements();
				this._render();
			}
		}
	};
	//Set it off
	Loop._init();
	//Loop.investigate();
	
</script>

<script>
        // script for Loop On-Store Experience
        if(Loop.status === 'active'){
            Loop.setKey('5b53299b9dbc479f3cdccf310330987718dd787d');

            $(document).on("click", "a[href='/checkout']", function(e){
                e.preventDefault()
                e.stopPropagation()
                var $cartWrapper = $(this).closest('.cart-dropdown')
                var cartItems = [];
                $cartWrapper.find('.cart-item').each(function(index, item){
                    var itemQty = $(item).data("quantity")
                    for(var i=0;i<itemQty;i++){
                        cartItems.push($(item).data('variant-id'));
                    }
                });
                Loop.submit(cartItems);
            })
        }
    </script>

function lazyLoadImages(entries, observer){
    entries.forEach(entry => {
        if(entry.isIntersecting){
            var src;
            var pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio;
            if(window.innerWidth > 799){
                let parentElementWidth = entry.target.parentNode.clientWidth
                let srcWidth = Math.round(parentElementWidth * pixelRatio)
                let originalSrc = entry.target.getAttribute("data-src")
                src = Shopify.resizeImage(originalSrc, srcWidth+"x")
            } else{
                let parentElementWidth = entry.target.parentNode.clientWidth
                let srcWidth = Math.round(parentElementWidth * pixelRatio)
                let originalSrc = entry.target.getAttribute("data-mobile-src")
                src = Shopify.resizeImage(originalSrc, srcWidth+"x")
            }
            entry.target.setAttribute("src", src)
            observer.unobserve(entry.target)
        }
        // console.log("imageObserver" ,entry.intersectionRatio, entry.isIntersecting, src)
        // Each entry describes an intersection change for one observed
        // target element:
        //   entry.boundingClientRect
        //   entry.intersectionRatio
        //   entry.intersectionRect
        //   entry.isIntersecting
        //   entry.rootBounds
        //   entry.target
        //   entry.time
    });
}

function lazyLoadVideos(entries, observer){
    entries.forEach(entry => {
        var src;
        var posterSrc;
        if(window.innerWidth > 799){
            src = entry.target.getAttribute("data-src")
            posterSrc = entry.target.getAttribute("data-poster")
        } else{
            src = entry.target.getAttribute("data-mobile-src")
            posterSrc = entry.target.getAttribute("data-mobile-poster")
        }
        entry.target.setAttribute("poster", posterSrc)
        entry.target.querySelector("source").setAttribute("src", src)
        entry.target.load()
        observer.unobserve(entry.target)
        // console.log("videoObserver", entry.intersectionRatio, entry.isIntersecting, src)
        // Each entry describes an intersection change for one observed
        // target element:
        //   entry.boundingClientRect
        //   entry.intersectionRatio
        //   entry.intersectionRect
        //   entry.isIntersecting
        //   entry.rootBounds
        //   entry.target
        //   entry.time
    });
}

function checkIfUserInEU(){
    $.ajax({
        type:"GET",
        url:"https://api.ipdata.co/is_eu?api-key=6174eebd189b7b4ee98692f32955020f6d3c714a4cd6e57ce57553ef",
        success: function(data){
            if(data === "true"){
                $.cookie("isEU", "true", { expires: 30 })
            } else{
                $.cookie("isEU", "false", { expires: 30 })
            }
            showCookieBannerIfUserInEU()
        },
        error: function(data){
            $.cookie("isEU", "true", { expires: 30 })
            showCookieBannerIfUserInEU()
        }
    })
}

function showCookieBannerIfUserInEU(){
    if($.cookie("isEU") === "true" && $.cookie("cookie-banner") !== "accepted"){
        $(".cookie-banner").show()
    }
}

function getBodyScrollTop() { 
    const el = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement 
    return el.scrollTop 
}

function isValidJSON(str) {
    try {
        JSON.parse(str);
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

function revealAnimationOnScroll() {
    var scrolled = $(window).scrollTop(),
    win_height_padded = $(window).height() * 1.1;
    $(".revealOnScroll:not(.animated)").each(function () {
        var offsetTop = $(this).offset().top;
        if (scrolled + win_height_padded > offsetTop) {
            if ($(this).data('delay')) {
                $(this).addClass('animated ' + $(this).data('animation') + " delay-" + $(this).data('delay'));
            } else {
                $(this).addClass('animated ' + $(this).data('animation'));
            }
        }
    });
}

        }
    }
}

var validateEmail = function(email) {
    var re = /^(([^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@\"]+(\.[^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@\"]+)*)|(\".+\"))@((\[[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\])|(([a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}))$/;
    return re.test(email);
}

var prevWindowWidth = $(window).width();
function updateHeroVideoOnResize(){
    if($(window).width() < 800 && prevWindowWidth >= 800){
        playMobileHeroVideo()
    } else if($(window).width() >= 800 && prevWindowWidth < 800){
        playDesktopHeroVideo()
    }
    prevWindowWidth = $(window).width();
}

function toggleCart(){
    if(window.location.href.indexOf('/cart') === -1){
        $(".cart-dropdown").toggleClass("active")
    }
    // hide additional checkout buttons and affirm messaging if Loop on store experience is active
    if(Loop.status === "active"){
        $(".affirm-as-low-as").hide()
        $("#additional_checkout_buttons").hide()
    }
}

function closeCart(){
    if(window.location.href.indexOf('/cart') === -1){
        $(".cart-dropdown").removeClass("active")
        $('#livechat-compact-container').css("display","block")
    }
}

/**
  * @desc removes line item from cart using Shopify AJAX API
  * @param {string|integer} id - the key the line item to be removed
  * @return
*/
function removeFromCartById(vid, title){
    if(title.indexOf("Saturday") !== -1 && title.indexOf('Kit') == -1){
        data = { updates: { [vid]: 0, 19404871598176: 0}}
        $.ajax({
            url:' /cart/update.js',
            type: "POST",
            data: data,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(response){
                dataLayer.push({
                    'event': 'removeFromCart', // This value must not change
                    'type': 'Remove'
                });
                ajaxDropdownCartUpdate()
            },
            error: function(response, error){
                alert(status, error)
            }
        });
    } else{
        data = { quantity: 0, id: vid }
        $.ajax({
            url:' /cart/change.js',
            type: "POST",
            data: data,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(response){
                dataLayer.push({
                    'event': 'removeFromCart', // This value must not change
                    'type': 'Remove'
                });
                ajaxDropdownCartUpdate()
            },
            error: function(response, error){
                alert(status, error)
            }
        });
    }
}

function ajaxUpdateLineItem(id, newVal, cart){
    $("#cartToggle h2").text("Bag ("+cart.item_count+")");
    var cartPrice = Shopify.formatMoney(cart.total_price)
    // var quadpayPrice = Shopify.formatMoney(cart.total_price / 4)
    if(cartPrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
        cartPrice = cartPrice.substring(0,cartPrice.indexOf("."))
    }
    $(".subtotal-price").text(cartPrice)
    // $('.quadpayPrice').text(quadpayPrice)
    for(var i=0;i<cart.items.length;i++){
        item = cart.items[i]
        var $cartItemWrapper = $(".cart-item[data-id='"+item.key+"']")
        if(id = item.key){
            var retrievedPriceObject = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(item.id))
            var unitPrice = retrievedPriceObject['price']
            var unitComparePrice = retrievedPriceObject['comparePrice']
            var newTotalPrice = unitPrice*item.quantity;
            var newTotalComparePrice = unitComparePrice*item.quantity;
            newTotalPrice = Shopify.formatMoney(newTotalPrice);
            if(newTotalPrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
                newTotalPrice = newTotalPrice.substring(0,newTotalPrice.indexOf("."));
            }
            // update line item price
            if(newTotalComparePrice > 0){
                newTotalComparePrice  = Shopify.formatMoney(newTotalComparePrice)
                if(newTotalComparePrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
                    newTotalComparePrice = newTotalComparePrice.substring(0,newTotalComparePrice.indexOf("."));
                }
                $cartItemWrapper.find(".sale-price h3:first-of-type").text(newTotalComparePrice)
                $cartItemWrapper.find(".sale-price h3:last-of-type").text(newTotalPrice)
            } else{
                $cartItemWrapper.find(".price h3").text(newTotalPrice)
            }
            // update line item quantity
            $cartItemWrapper.data("quantity", newVal)
            $cartItemWrapper.find(".loading-bars").removeClass("active");
            $cartItemWrapper.find(".qty").text(newVal);
            $cartItemWrapper.find("input.qty_input").attr('value', newVal);
        }
    }
}

function ajaxDropdownCartUpdate(showCart){
    if (showCart === undefined){ showCart = true }
    var cartWrapper = $('.cart-dropdown .cart-item-wrapper')
    cartWrapper.empty()
    Shopify.getCart(function(cart){
        // Replace old cart count with new number of items in cart
        $("#cartToggle h2").text("Bag ("+cart.item_count+")");

        // get total value of new cart
        var cartTotal = Shopify.formatMoney(cart.total_price);
        if(cartTotal.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
            cartTotal = cartTotal.substring(0,cartTotal.indexOf("."))
        }
        $(".subtotal-price").text(cartTotal)

        // Handles adding first item to cart and removing last item from cart
        var cartCTAString = "";
        if(cart.item_count > 0 && $(".cart-dropdown.empty").length > 0){
            $(".cart-dropdown").removeClass("empty");
            $(".cart-dropdown").addClass("items")
            $(".cart-dropdown>.cta").remove()
            $("#additional_checkout_buttons").show()
            $(".cart-dropdown .affirm-as-low-as").show()
            cartCTAString = "<a href='/checkout' class='cta'><h2>Checkout</h2></a>"
            $(".shipping-text").after(cartCTAString)
        } else if(cart.item_count == 0){
            $(".cart-dropdown").removeClass("items");
            $(".cart-dropdown").addClass("empty")
            $(".cart-dropdown>.cta").remove()
            $("#additional_checkout_buttons").hide()
            $(".cart-dropdown .affirm-as-low-as").hide()
            cartCTAString = ""+
            "<a href='/collections/womens' class='cta'><h2>SHOP WOMEN</h2></a>"+
            "<a href='/collections/mens' class='cta'><h2>SHOP MEN</h2></a>"
            $(".discount-code-notification").after(cartCTAString)
            $(".cart-item-wrapper").append("<h5>Your cart is empty.</h5>")
            $(".discount-code-notification").empty()
        }

        // update affirm price
        $('.cart-dropdown .affirm-as-low-as').attr('data-amount',cart.total_price);
        affirm.ui.refresh();

        // append items to dropdown menu one by one
        cart.items.forEach(function(item) {
            appendItemToDropdownCart(item, cartWrapper)
        })

        updateUpsellInCart(cart)

        if(showCart){
            $(".cart-dropdown").addClass("active")
            $('#livechat-compact-container').css("display","none")
            // hide additional checkout buttons and affirm messaging if Loop on store experience is active
            if(Loop.status === "active"){
                $(".affirm-as-low-as").hide()
                $("#additional_checkout_buttons").hide()
            }
            if($(window).width() < 800){
                $('html, body').animate({
                    scrollTop: 0
                }, 500);
            }
        }
        $(document.body).css({'cursor' : 'auto'});
    })
}

function checkAndRemoveIfUpsellProductsInCart(cart, upsellProductsList){
    var upsellProductHandlesList = [];
    upsellProductsList.forEach(function(upsellProduct){
        if(upsellProduct.available){
            upsellProductHandlesList.push(upsellProduct.handle)
        }
    })
    cart.items.forEach(function(item){
        var upsellIndex = upsellProductHandlesList.indexOf(item.handle)
        if(upsellIndex !== -1){
            upsellProductHandlesList.splice(upsellIndex,1)
        }
    })
    return upsellProductHandlesList
}

// 1. Identifies 'heavyweight' product and get list of products to upsell
// 2. Removes products from list if they're already in cart or are completely sold out
// 3. If no products to show, use fallback collections
function updateUpsellInCart(cart){
    $('.cart-upsell').remove()
    if(cart.items.length){
        var upsellProductsHTML = $("#upsell-products").html()
        var allUpsellProductsArray = JSON.parse(upsellProductsHTML)
        var backupUpsellCollections = allUpsellProductsArray[allUpsellProductsArray.length-1]
        var essential75SweaterInCart = false;
        var combInCart = false;
        var priorityArray = ["fall-2019","mix-n-match","complete-set","accessories-2019","carryover","carryover-tee"]
        var upsellProductsArray = [];

        cart.items.forEach(function(item){
            var currentItemHandle = item.handle
            allUpsellProductsArray.forEach(function(product){
                var upsellProductHandle = product.handle
                if(currentItemHandle == upsellProductHandle){
                    var upsellProductType = product.upsellType
                    var upsellProductPriority = priorityArray.indexOf(upsellProductType)
                    var upsellProductPrice = product.price
                    upsellProductsArray.push({
                        upsellPriority:upsellProductPriority,
                        price: upsellProductPrice,
                        upsellCollection: product.upsellCollection,
                        type: upsellProductType,
                        parentProduct: currentItemHandle
                    })
                }
            })

            // checks if there's a $75 sweater in the cart
            if(item.handle.indexOf('75') !== -1){
                essential75SweaterInCart = true; 
            }
            // checks if there's a comb in the cart
            if(item.handle.indexOf('comb') !== -1){
                combInCart = true;
            }
        })

        var upsellPromoName;
        if(upsellProductsArray.length){
            var heavyweightProducts = [];
            var highestPriority = 100;
            var finalHeavyweightProduct;
            upsellProductsArray.forEach(function(product){
                if(product.upsellPriority < highestPriority){
                    highestPriority = product.upsellPriority
                }
            })
            upsellProductsArray.forEach(function(product){
                if(highestPriority == product.upsellPriority){
                    heavyweightProducts.push(product)
                }
            })
            if(heavyweightProducts.length > 1){
                var highestPrice = 0;
                heavyweightProducts.forEach(function(product){
                    if(product.price > highestPrice){
                        highestPrice = product.price
                    }
                })
                heavyweightProducts.forEach(function(product){
                    if(product.price == highestPrice){
                        finalHeavyweightProduct = product
                    }
                })
            } else if(heavyweightProducts.length == 1){
                finalHeavyweightProduct = heavyweightProducts[0]
            }
            productsToUpsell = checkAndRemoveIfUpsellProductsInCart(cart, finalHeavyweightProduct.upsellCollection)
            if(productsToUpsell.length){
                upsellPromoName = finalHeavyweightProduct.type+" "+finalHeavyweightProduct.parentProduct
                showUpsellInCart(productsToUpsell, upsellPromoName)
            } else{
                // use fallback collections
                var backupCollectionHandle = priorityArray[finalHeavyweightProduct.upsellPriority]
                var backupProductsList = backupUpsellCollections[backupCollectionHandle]
                backupProductsList = checkAndRemoveIfUpsellProductsInCart(cart,backupProductsList)
                upsellPromoName = "fallback "+finalHeavyweightProduct.type+" "+finalHeavyweightProduct.parentProduct
                showUpsellInCart(backupProductsList, upsellPromoName)
            }
        } else if(essential75SweaterInCart && !combInCart){
            upsellPromoName = '75s cashmere-comb'
            showUpsellInCart(["cashmere-comb"], upsellPromoName)
        } else if(essential75SweaterInCart && combInCart){
            // fallback 75 sweater collection
            var backupProductsList = backupUpsellCollections['75s']
            backupProductsList = checkAndRemoveIfUpsellProductsInCart(cart,backupProductsList)
            upsellPromoName = 'backup 75s'
            showUpsellInCart(backupProductsList, upsellPromoName)
        }
    }
    return
}

function showUpsellInCart(productsToShow, upsellPromoName){
    var htmlString = '';
    var upsellInner = '';
    var counter = 0;
    var swiperContainerClass = '';
    var swiperWrapperClass = '';
    var swiperSlideClass = '';
    var swiperButtons ='';
    if(productsToShow.length > 1){
        swiperContainerClass = ' swiper-container';
        swiperWrapperClass = ' swiper-wrapper';
        swiperSlideClass = ' swiper-slide';
        swiperButtons = ''+
        '<div class="swiper-button-next"></div>'+
        '<div class="swiper-button-prev"></div>'
    }
    productsToShow.forEach(function(handle){
        Shopify.getProduct(handle,function(product){
            var quickAddButtons = "";
            var finalSaleInput = "";
            var combClass = "";
            var imageSrc = Shopify.resizeImage(product.featured_image, '150x150')
            var price = Shopify.formatMoney(product.price)
            var comparePrice = Shopify.formatMoney(product.compare_at_price)
            var priceWithoutCurrency = price.substring(1);
            if(price.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
                price = price.substring(0,price.indexOf("."));
            }
            if(price < comparePrice){
                finalSaleInput = ""+
                "<input type='hidden' id='finalSale' name='properties[Final-Sale]' value='true'>"+
                "<input type='hidden' id='loopFinalSale' name='properties[_LPROP]' value='Final Sale'>"
            }
            if(handle == "cashmere-comb"){
                combClass = " active comb"
            }
            product.variants.forEach(function(variant){
                var soldoutAttribute = "";
                var option2 = ''
                if(handle == "cashmere-comb"){
                    option2 = "ADD TO CART"
                } else{
                    option2 = variant.option2;
                }
                if(!variant.available){
                    soldoutAttribute = "class='soldout' disabled"
                }
                quickAddButtons += ""+
                "<button "+
                    "style='display:none;'"+
                    "type='submit'"+
                    "name='id'"+
                    "value='"+variant.id+"'"+
                    "data-value='"+variant.option2+"'"+
                    "data-price='"+variant.price+"'"+
                    "data-compare-price='"+variant.compare_at_price+"'"+
                    soldoutAttribute+">"+
                    option2+
                "</button>"
            })
            upsellInner += ""+
            "<div class='upsell-item"+swiperSlideClass+"'>"+
                "<img class='upsell-item-image' src='"+imageSrc+"' alt='product-featured_image'>"+
                "<div class='details'>"+
                    "<a class='cart-product-link' href='/products/"+product.handle+"'><h3>"+product.title+"</h3></a>"+
                    "<h4>"+price+"</h4>"+
                    "<div class='upsell-item-cta"+combClass+"'>SELECT A SIZE</div>"+
                    "<form action='/cart/add' method='post' enctype='multipart/form-data' data-upsell-name='"+upsellPromoName+"'>"+
                        "<input type='hidden' name='type' value='"+product.type+"'>"+
                        "<input type='hidden' name='title' value='"+product.title+"'>"+
                        "<input type='hidden' name='color' value='"+product.variants[0].option1+"'>"+
                        "<input type='hidden' name='price' value='"+priceWithoutCurrency+"'>"+
                        "<input type='hidden' name='quantity' value='1'/>"+
                        finalSaleInput+
                        quickAddButtons+
                    "</form>"+
                "</div>"+
            "</div>"
            counter++
            if(counter == productsToShow.length){
                htmlString = ""+
                "<div class='cart-upsell"+swiperContainerClass+"'>"+
                    "<h3>YOU MAY ALSO LIKE</h3>"+
                    "<div class='"+swiperWrapperClass+"'>"+
                        upsellInner+
                    "</div>"+
                    swiperButtons+
                "</div>"
                $('.cart-upsell-wrapper').append(htmlString)
                if(productsToShow.length > 1 && $(window).width() > 799){
                    var swiper = new Swiper('.cart-upsell.swiper-container', {
                        navigation: {
                            nextEl: '.cart-upsell .swiper-button-next',
                            prevEl: '.cart-upsell .swiper-button-prev',
                        },
                        loop:true,
                        observer: true,
                        observeParents: true,
                        allowTouchMove:false,
                        on: {
                            reachEnd: function(){
                                this.slideToLoop(0)
                            },
                            reachBeginning: function(){
                                this.slideToLoop(this.slides.length-3)
                            }
                        }
                    });
                } else if(productsToShow.length > 1){
                    var swiper = new Swiper('.cart-upsell.swiper-container', {
                        navigation: {
                            nextEl: '.cart-upsell .swiper-button-next',
                            prevEl: '.cart-upsell .swiper-button-prev',
                        },
                        loop:true,
                        observer: true,
                        observeParents: true,
                        allowTouchMove:true,
                        on: {
                            reachEnd: function(){
                                this.slideToLoop(0)
                            },
                            reachBeginning: function(){
                                this.slideToLoop(this.slides.length-3)
                            }
                        }
                    })
                }
                if(!$.cookie("upsellShown")){
                    dataLayer.push({
                        'event': 'upsellShown',
                        'upsell': 'Shown',
                        'ecommerce': {
                            'promoView': {
                                'promotions': [{
                                    'name': "Upsell In Cart",
                                    'creative': upsellPromoName
                                }]
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    $.cookie("upsellShown", true)
                }
            }
        })
    })
}

function appendItemToDropdownCart(item, cartWrapper){
    // console.log(item)
    var retrievedPriceObject = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(item.id))
    var saleItem = false;
    if(retrievedPriceObject['comparePrice'] !== 0){
        saleItem = true;
        var price = Shopify.formatMoney(retrievedPriceObject['price'])
        var comparePrice = Shopify.formatMoney(retrievedPriceObject['comparePrice'])
        if(price.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
            price = price.substring(0,price.indexOf("."));
        }
        if(comparePrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
            comparePrice = comparePrice.substring(0,comparePrice.indexOf("."));
        }
    }
    var imageUrl = Shopify.resizeImage(item.image, '150x150');
    var itemTotal = Shopify.formatMoney(item.line_price);
    if(itemTotal.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
        itemTotal = itemTotal.substring(0,itemTotal.indexOf("."));
    }
    var saturdaySkinPromoItem = false
    var preorderItem = false;
    var monogrammedItem = false;
    var monogram = false;
    var finalSale = false;
    if(item.handle == 'saturday-skin-care-kit'){ saturdaySkinPromoItem = true }
    if(item.properties && item.properties["Note"]){ preorderItem = true; }
    if(item.properties && item.properties["Monogram"] && item.properties["Monogram"] !== ""){ monogrammedItem = true; }
    if(item.product_type === "Monogram"){ monogram = true; }
    // console.log(item.properties)
    if(item.properties && item.properties["_LPROP"] == "Final Sale"){ finalSale = true; }

    var wrapperOpen = "<div class='cart-item' data-id='"+item.key+"' data-variant-id="+item.variant_id+" data-quantity="+item.quantity+">";
    var img = "<img class='cart-item-image' src='"+imageUrl+"'>";
    var detailsOpen = "<div class='details'>";
    var productTitle = "<a class='cart-product-link' href='"+item.url+"'>"+"<h3>"+item.product_title+"</h3>"+"</a>";
    var sizeDetail = "<h4>Size: "+item.variant_options[1]+"</h4>";
    var colorDetail = "<h4>Color: "+item.variant_options[0]+"</h4>";
    var monogramDetail = "";
    var preorderDetail = "";
    var finalSaleDetail = "";
    var priceSection = "";
    if(saleItem){
        priceSection = ""+
        "<span class='sale-price'>"+
            "<h3 style='text-decoration:line-through;'>"+comparePrice+"</h3>"+
            "<h3 style='color:#B25956;'>"+price+"</h3>"+
        "</span>"
    } else{
        priceSection = "<h3>"+itemTotal+"</h3>"
    }
    var quantityPriceSection = ""+
    "<div class='qp-wrapper'>"+
        "<div class='quantity'>"+
            "<button type='button' class='qty_adjust qty_adjust--minus'>-</button>"+
            "<span class='qty'>"+item.quantity+"</span>"+
            "<input class='qty_input' type='hidden' value='"+item.quantity+"' min='0' data-id='"+item.id+"' data-handle='"+item.handle+"' data-quantity='"+item.quantity+"'>"+
            "<button type='button' class='qty_adjust qty_adjust--plus'>+</button>"+
            "<div class='loading-container'>"+
                "<div class='loader'>"+
                    "<div class='loading-bars'>"+
                        "<div class='bar'></div>"+
                        "<div class='bar'></div>"+
                        "<div class='bar'></div>"+
                        "<div class='bar'></div>"+
                    "</div>"+
                "</div>"+
            "</div>"+
        "</div>"+
        "<div class='price'>"+
            priceSection+
        "</div>"+
    "</div>"
    var removeItem = ""+
    "<a href='javascript:void(0)' class='remove-item' data-id='"+item.key+"'>"+
        "<img src='//cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0313/7821/t/219/assets/x.svg?2187311307152586917'>"+
    "</a>"
    var detailsClose = "</div>";
    var wrapperClose = "</div>";
    if(monogram){
        productTitle = "<h3>"+item.product_title+"</h3>";
        quantityPriceSection = ""+
        "<div class='qp-wrapper'>"+
            "<div class='quantity'></div>"+
            "<div class='price'>"+
                priceSection+
            "</div>"+
        "</div>"
    }
    if(monogrammedItem){
        monogramDetail = "<h4>Monogrammed Item</h4>";
        quantityPriceSection = ""+
        "<div class='qp-wrapper'>"+
            "<div class='quantity'></div>"+
            "<div class='price'>"+
                priceSection+
            "</div>"+
        "</div>"
    }
    if(saturdaySkinPromoItem){
        quantityPriceSection = ""+
        "<div class='qp-wrapper'>"+
            "<div class='quantity'></div>"+
            "<div class='price'>"+
                priceSection+
            "</div>"+
        "</div>"
    }
    if(preorderItem){
      var preorderDetail = "<h4>Preorder Item</h4>";
    }
    if(finalSale){
        finalSaleDetail = "<h4 style='color:#B25956; font-weight:normal;'>Final Sale Item</h4>"
    }
    cartWrapper.append(wrapperOpen+img+detailsOpen+productTitle+sizeDetail+colorDetail+monogramDetail+preorderDetail+finalSaleDetail+quantityPriceSection+removeItem+detailsClose+wrapperClose)
}

function getUrlParam(name, url) {
    if (!url) url = window.location.href;
    name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "\\$&");
    var regex = new RegExp("[?&]" + name + "(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)"),
    results = regex.exec(url);
    if (!results) return null;
    if (!results[2]) return '';
    return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, " "));
}

function updateURLParam(param, paramVal, url){
    if (!url) url = window.location.href;
    var newAdditionalURL = "";
    var tempArray = url.split("?");
    var baseURL = tempArray[0];
    var additionalURL = tempArray[1];
    var temp = "";
    if (additionalURL) {
        tempArray = additionalURL.split("&");
        for (var i=0;i<tempArray.length;i++){
            if(tempArray[i].split('=')[0] != param){
                newAdditionalURL += temp + tempArray[i];
                temp = "&";
            }
        }
    }
    var rows_txt = temp + "" + param + "=" + paramVal;
    return baseURL + "?" + newAdditionalURL + rows_txt;
}

/**
  * @desc adds key value pairs to local storage where the key is the line item
  * id and the value is an object comprised of the price and comparePrice of
  * the line item. Used to quickly retrieve sale prices in the dropdown cart
*/
function addPriceObjectsToLocalStorage(){
    Shopify.getCart(function(cart){
        $.each(cart.items,function(i,item){
            Shopify.getProduct(item.handle,function(product){
                var priceObject = {}
                priceObject['price'] = product.price;
                priceObject['comparePrice'] = product.compare_at_price || 0;
                localStorage.setItem(item.id,JSON.stringify(priceObject))
            })
        })
    })
}

/**
  * @desc jQuery function that checks if the element it was called on is fully
  * within the viewport or not. Usually called within the window scroll event
  * listener and useful for tracking promotion impressions
  * @return bool - true if element is within viewport, false if not
*/
$.fn.isInViewport = function() {
    var elementTop = $(this).offset().top;
    var elementBottom = elementTop + $(this).outerHeight();
    var viewportTop = $(window).scrollTop();
    var viewportBottom = viewportTop + $(window).height();
    return elementBottom > viewportTop && elementTop < viewportBottom;
};

/**
  * @desc returns true if string is all uppercase, false if not
  * @param {string} str - string to be checked
  * @return bool - true if string is all uppercase
*/
function isUpperCase(str) { return str === str.toUpperCase() }

    function initializeProductRowSwiper(){
        return new Swiper('.product-row.swiper-container', {
            direction: 'horizontal',
            slidesPerView: 'auto',
            freeMode: true,
            scrollbar: {
                el: '.product-row .swiper-scrollbar',
                draggable:true
            },
            mousewheel:{
                forceToAxis:true,
                invert:true
            }
        });
    }

    function addProductsToSTLModal(productList, selectedLook){
        var htmlString = "";
        productList.forEach(function(product){
            var priceSection = "";
            var colorSwatches = "";
            var sizeSwatches = "";
            var promoDisclaimer = "";
            var featured_image = Shopify.resizeImage(product.featured_image, '600x600')
            var secondary_image = Shopify.resizeImage(product.secondary_image, '600x600')
            var formattedPrice = Shopify.formatMoney(product.price)
            var formattedComparePrice = Shopify.formatMoney(product.comparePrice)
            if(formattedPrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
                formattedPrice = formattedPrice.substring(0,formattedPrice.indexOf("."));
            }
            if(formattedComparePrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
                formattedComparePrice = formattedComparePrice.substring(0,formattedComparePrice.indexOf("."));
            }
            if(product.price < product.comparePrice){
                priceSection = ""+
                "<h3 class='price compare'>"+formattedComparePrice+"</h3>"+
                "<h3 class='price sale'>"+formattedPrice+"</h3>"
                promoDisclaimer = "<div class='disclaimer'>This item is final sale. No exchanges or returns.</div>"
            } else {
                priceSection = ""+
                "<h3 class='price'>"+formattedPrice+"</h3>"
            }
            // PROMODISCLAIMER FOR DISCOUNT CODE SALES
            // if(product.tags.indexOf("SALE") !== -1 || product.tags.indexOf("sale") !== -1){
            //     promoDisclaimer = "<div class='disclaimer'>Save 20% with code FALL20</div>"
            // }
            var variantCollection = [];
            selectedLook.allProducts.forEach(function(lookProduct){
                if(product.styleName == lookProduct.styleName){
                    variantCollection.push(lookProduct)
                }
            })
            variantCollection.forEach(function(variantProduct){
                var selected = '';
                if(variantProduct.handle == product.handle){
                    selected = "class='selected' checked"
                }
                colorSwatches += ""+
                "<div class='swatch swatch-element color "+variantProduct.colorHandle+"' data-handle='"+variantProduct.handle+"'>"+
                    "<input id='"+variantProduct.handle+"' name='look-"+selectedLook.lookNumber+"-"+product.styleNameHandle+"-color' type='radio' data-color='"+variantProduct.color+"' "+selected+">"+
                    "<label for='"+variantProduct.handle+"'></label>"+
                "</div>"
            })
            product.variants.forEach(function(variant){
                var soldoutClass = '';
                if(!variant.available){
                    soldoutClass = "class='soldout'"
                }
                sizeSwatches += ""+
                "<div data-value='"+variant.size+"' class='swatch swatch-element' data-swatch-handle='"+variant.sizeHandle+"'>"+
                    "<input id='"+product.handle+"-"+variant.sizeHandle+"' type='radio' name='look-"+selectedLook.lookNumber+"-"+product.styleNameHandle+"-size' value='"+variant.sizeHandle+"' data-value='"+variant.sizeHandle+"' data-variant-id='"+variant.id+"' data-role='none' "+soldoutClass+">"+
                    "<label for='"+product.handle+"-"+variant.sizeHandle+"'>"+variant.size+"</label>"+
                "</div>"
            })
            var preorderInput, preorderDisclaimer;
            if(product.preorderShipDate === ""){
                preorderInput = "";
                preorderDisclaimer = "";
            } else{
                preorderInput = "<input type='hidden' id='preorderNote' name='properties[Note]' value='Preorder' data-role='none'>";
                preorderDisclaimer = "Shipping by <span>"+product.preorderShipDate+"</span>";
            }
            var finalSaleInput = ""
            if(product.price < product.comparePrice){
                finalSaleInput = "<input type='hidden' name='properties[Final-Sale]' value='true'>"
            }
            htmlString += ""+
            "<div class='stl-product'>"+
                "<div class='images swiper-container'>"+
                    "<div class='swiper-wrapper'>"+
                        "<img class='swiper-slide image-1' src="+featured_image+">"+
                        "<img class='swiper-slide image-2' src="+secondary_image+">"+
                    "</div>"+
                    "<div class='swiper-pagination'></div>"+
                    "<div class='swiper-button-next'></div>"+
                    "<div class='swiper-button-prev'></div>"+
                "</div>"+
                "<div class='details'>"+
                "<h2>"+product.styleName+"</h2>"+
                "<div class='price-wrapper'>"+priceSection+"</div>"+
                "<h3 class='color-name'>"+product.color+"</h3>"+
                "<div class='color-swatches'>"+colorSwatches+"</div>"+
                "<form action='/cart/add' method='post' enctype='multipart/form-data' class='stl-add-to-cart-form' data-role='none'>"+
                    "<input type='hidden' name='type' value='"+product.type+"'>"+
                    "<input type='hidden' name='title' value='"+product.title+"'>"+
                    "<input type='hidden' name='color' value='"+product.color+"'>"+
                    "<input type='hidden' name='comparePrice' value='"+product.comparePrice+"'>"+
                    "<input type='hidden' name='price' value='"+product.price+"'>"+
                    "<input type='hidden' name='id' value=''/>"+
                    "<input type='hidden' name='quantity' value='1'/>"+
                    preorderInput+
                    finalSaleInput+
                    "<h3 class='size-name'>Select a size</h3>"+
                    "<div class='size-swatches'>"+sizeSwatches+"</div>"+
                    "<a href='/products/"+product.handle+"' class='stl-product-link' target='_blank'><h4>View Product Page</h4></a>"+
                    promoDisclaimer+
                    "<div class='preorder-ship'>"+
                        preorderDisclaimer+
                    "</div>"+
                    "<button class='stl-product-add-to-cart' class='btn btn--dark' type='submit' name='add'>Add to Cart</button>"+
                "</form>"+
                "</div>"+
            "</div>"
        })
        $(".stl-products").append(htmlString)
        // add back to cart button at the bottom if on mobile
        if($(window).width() < 800){
            backToTopHtml = ""+
            "<div class='back-to-top cta-wrapper'>"+
                "<h4>BACK TO TOP</h4>"+
            "</div>"
            $(".stl-products").append(backToTopHtml)
        }
        // initialize image carousels
        $(".stl-product .swiper-container").each(function(){
            var $pagination = $(this).find(".swiper-pagination")
            var $navigationNext = $(this).find('.swiper-button-next')
            var $navigationPrev = $(this).find('.swiper-button-prev')
            var swiper = new Swiper($(this),{
                pagination:{
                    el: $pagination,
                    clickable: true,
                    bulletActiveClass: 'active'
                },
                navigation: {
                    nextEl: $navigationNext,
                    prevEl: $navigationPrev,
                  }
            })
        })
        // select initial size swatches
        $(".stl-product form").each(function(){
            var $sizeToSelect = $(this).find(".size-swatches input:not(.soldout)").first()
            var initialVariantId = $sizeToSelect.data("variant-id");
            $(this).find("input[name=id]").val(initialVariantId)
            var inputVal = $sizeToSelect.closest(".swatch-element").data("value")
            switch(inputVal) {
                case "OS":
                    $(this).find('.size-name').html("One Size");
                    break;
                case "XS":
                    $(this).find('.size-name').html("Extra Small");
                    break;
                case "S":
                    $(this).find('.size-name').html("Small");
                    break;
                case "M":
                    $(this).find('.size-name').html("Medium");
                    break;
                case "L":
                    $(this).find('.size-name').html("Large");
                    break;
                case "XL":
                    $(this).find('.size-name').html("Extra Large");
                    break;
            }
            $sizeToSelect.prop("checked", true)
            $sizeToSelect.addClass("selected")
        })
    }

    let images = document.querySelectorAll(".preload-placeholder") 
    images.forEach(function(img){
        var src;
        var pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio;
        if(window.innerWidth > 799){
            let parentElementWidth = img.parentNode.clientWidth
            let srcWidth = Math.round(parentElementWidth * pixelRatio)
            let originalSrc = img.getAttribute("data-src")
            src = Shopify.resizeImage(originalSrc, srcWidth+"x")
        } else{
            let parentElementWidth = img.parentNode.clientWidth
            let srcWidth = Math.round(parentElementWidth * pixelRatio)
            let originalSrc = img.getAttribute("data-mobile-src")
            src = Shopify.resizeImage(originalSrc, srcWidth+"x")
        }
        img.setAttribute("src", src)
        img.onload = function(){ this.classList.remove("preload-placeholder") }
    })

    $(document).ready(function(){

        // Notify me close toggle
        $(".notify-modal, .notify-modal__close").click(function(){
            $(".notify-modal").removeClass("active")

            bodyScrollLock.enableBodyScroll(targetElement);

        // Do not close modal if clicked inside
        $(".notify-modal__inner").click(function(e){

        })

        // notify modal submission
        $(".notify-modal form").submit(function(e){
            e.preventDefault();
            var $form = $(this);
            if($form.find(".checkbox-input-wrapper.terms input").is(":checked")){
                $("body").css("cursor", "progress");
                // Let's select and cache all the fields
                var submitBtn = $form.find("button[type=submit]");
                var imageUrl = $(".notify-modal__image img").attr("src");
                var email = $form.find("input[name=email]").val();
                var variantId = $form.find("input[name=variantId]").val();
                var productId = $form.find("input[name=productId]").val();
                var price = $form.find("input[name=price]").val();
                // Serialize the data in the form
                if (validateEmail(email)) {
                    // Let's disable the inputs for the duration of the Ajax request.
                    // Note: we disable elements AFTER the form data has been serialized.
                    // Disabled form elements will not be serialized.
                    submitBtn.prop("disabled", true);
                    window._swat.sendWatchlist(
                        email,
                        "email",
                        {
                            epi: variantId,
                            empi: productId,
                            iu: imageUrl,
                            pr: price
                        }, 
                        function(r){ 
                            submitBtn.prop("disabled", false);
                            $("body").css("cursor", "default");
                            $('.notify-modal').removeClass("active")
                            const targetElement = document.querySelector(".notify-modal__inner");
                            bodyScrollLock.enableBodyScroll(targetElement);
                            dataLayer.push({
                                'event': 'signup',
                                'type': 'Notify Me'
                            })
                        },
                        function(error){
                            alert("There was an error. Reload the page and try again.")
                            $("body").css("cursor", "default");
                            // console.log(error)
                        });
                   
                }
            } else{
                $form.find(".checkbox-input-wrapper.terms").css({ 'border': '2px solid red', 'padding': '2px' })
            }
        });

        // STL Add to Cart
        $(document).on('submit', '.stl-add-to-cart-form', function(e){
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            var $form = $(this).closest('form');
            var $submitBtn = $form.find(".stl-product-add-to-cart")
            if($submitBtn.hasClass("disabled")){
                // TODO
                // add image
                var notifyProductTitle = $form.find("input[name=title]").val()
                var notifyVariantId = $form.find("input[name=id]").val()
                var lookNumber = $(".current-look").text()
                var notifyProductId;
                var notifyImageSrc;
                var notifyProductPrice;
                var selectedLook;
                stlLooks.forEach(function(look){
                    if(look.lookNumber == lookNumber){
                        selectedLook = look;
                        selectedLook.allProducts.forEach(function(product){
                            if(notifyProductTitle === product.title){
                                notifyImageSrc = Shopify.resizeImage(product.featured_image, "400x400")
                                notifyProductId = product.id;
                                notifyProductPrice = product.price
                            }
                        })
                    }
                })
                $(".notify-modal__image img").attr("src",notifyImageSrc)
                $(".notify-modal__main>h3").text(notifyProductTitle)
                $(".notify-modal__main>input[name=product]").val(notifyProductTitle)
                $(".notify-modal__main>input[name=variantId]").val(notifyVariantId)
                $(".notify-modal__main>input[name=productId]").val(notifyProductId)
                $(".notify-modal__main>input[name=price]").val(notifyProductPrice)

                var sizeSelected = $form.find(".swatch input:checked").val()
                var variantSelected = $form.find(".swatch input:checked").data("variant-id")
                $(".notify-modal__main input[name=variantId]").val(variantSelected)
                switch(sizeSelected){
                    case "os":
                        sizeSelected = "O/S";
                        break;
                    case "xs":
                        sizeSelected = "Extra Small";
                        break;
                    case "s":
                        sizeSelected = "Small";
                        break;
                    case "m":
                        sizeSelected = "Medium";
                        break;
                    case "l":
                        sizeSelected = "Large";
                        break;
                    case "xl":
                        sizeSelected = "Extra Large";
                        break;
                    case "s/m":
                        sizeSelected = "Small/Medium";
                        break;
                    case "l/xl":
                        sizeSelected = "Large/Extra Large";
                        break;
                }
                const targetElement = document.querySelector(".notify-modal__inner");
                bodyScrollLock.disableBodyScroll(targetElement);
                $(".notify-modal").addClass("active")
                $(".notify-modal__main h4").text("Size "+sizeSelected)
            } else{
                $(document.body).css({'cursor' : 'wait'});
                var priceObject = {};
                priceObject['price'] = parseInt($form.find("input[name=price]").val());
                priceObject['comparePrice'] = parseInt($form.find("input[name=comparePrice]").val());
                var variantId = $form.find("input[name=id]").val();
                var $formData = $form.serialize();
                var lookNumber = parseInt($(".current-look").text())
                $.ajax({
                    type: "POST",
                    url: "/cart/add.js",
                    data: $formData,
                    dataType: "JSON",
                    success: function(data) {
                        localStorage.setItem(variantId,JSON.stringify(priceObject))
                        // Push data to Data Layer
                        dataLayer.push({
                            'event': 'addToCart', // This value must not change
                            'type': 'STL Add'
                        });
                        // LiveConnectData
                        window.liQ = window.liQ || [];
                        window.liQ.push({
                            "event": "addToCart",
                            "name": "",
                            "email": "",
                            "items": [
                                {
                                    "id": $form.find("input[name=id]").val(),
                                    "price": $form.find("input[name=price]").val(),
                                    "quantity": 1,
                                    "currency": "USD"
                                }
                            ]
                        });
                        // Update cart with new item
                        if($(window).width() < 800){
                            var showCart = false
                            ajaxDropdownCartUpdate(showCart);
                            $form.find(".stl-product-add-to-cart").text("Item Added To Cart")
                            $form.find(".stl-product-add-to-cart").addClass("disabled")
                            setTimeout(function(){
                                $form.find(".stl-product-add-to-cart").text("Add To Cart")
                                $form.find(".stl-product-add-to-cart").removeClass("disabled")
                            }, 2000)
                        } else{
                            ajaxDropdownCartUpdate();
                        }
                        // send event to Google Tag Manager
                        dataLayer.push({
                            'event': 'promotionClick',
                            'type': 'STL Add',
                            'ecommerce': {
                                'promoClick': {
                                    'promotions': [{
                                        'name': "HP Shop The Look",
                                        'creative': "Look "+lookNumber
                                    }]
                                }
                            }
                        })
                    },
                    error: function(data){
                        $(document.body).css({'cursor' : 'auto'});
                        alert("Last one left already added to cart!")
                    }
                });
            }
        })

        // STL color change
        $(document).on('change', '.color-swatches :radio', function (e) {
            var $el = $(e.target);
            var $item = $el.closest('.stl-product');
            var $swatchElement = $el.closest('.swatch-element');
            var $details = $el.closest('.details')
            var $swatchWrapper = $el.closest('.color-swatches');
            var selectedProductHandle = $swatchElement.data('handle')
            $item.find(".color-swatches input.selected").removeClass("selected")
            $swatchElement.find("input").addClass("selected")

            var lookNumber = $(".current-look").text()
            var productToShow;
            var selectedLook;
            stlLooks.forEach(function(look){
                if(look.lookNumber == lookNumber){
                    selectedLook = look;
                    selectedLook.allProducts.forEach(function(product){
                        if(selectedProductHandle === product.handle){
                            var $form = $item.find("form")
                            // update form input fields
                            $form.find("input[name=title]").val(product.title)
                            $form.find("input[name=color]").val(product.color)
                            // update carousel images
                            var image1Src = Shopify.resizeImage(product.featured_image, '600x600')
                            var image2Src = Shopify.resizeImage(product.secondary_image, '600x600')
                            $item.find(".image-1").attr("src",image1Src)
                            $item.find(".image-2").attr("src",image2Src)
                            // update product page link
                            $item.find(".stl-product-link").attr("href","/products/"+product.handle)
                            // update size availability
                            for(var i=0;i<product.variants.length;i++){
                                var variant = product.variants[i]
                                var $sizeInput = $item.find('.size-swatches input[data-value="'+variant.sizeHandle+'"]')
                                $sizeInput.data("variant-id",""+variant.id)
                                if(variant.available) {
                                    $sizeInput.removeClass('soldout');
                                } else{
                                    $sizeInput.addClass('soldout');
                                }
                            }
                            // update variant-id for selected size swatch
                            var $previouslySelectedSize = $form.find(".size-swatches input.selected")
                            $previouslySelectedSize.removeClass("selected")
                            var $sizeToSelect = $form.find(".size-swatches input[value="+$previouslySelectedSize.val()+"]")
                            if($sizeToSelect.hasClass("soldout")){
                                $sizeToSelect = $form.find(".size-swatches input:not(.soldout)").first()
                            }
                            var inputVal = $sizeToSelect.closest(".swatch-element").data("value")
                            switch(inputVal) {
                                case "OS":
                                    $form.find('.size-name').html("One Size");
                                    break;
                                case "XS":
                                    $form.find('.size-name').html("Extra Small");
                                    break;
                                case "S":
                                    $form.find('.size-name').html("Small");
                                    break;
                                case "M":
                                    $form.find('.size-name').html("Medium");
                                    break;
                                case "L":
                                    $form.find('.size-name').html("Large");
                                    break;
                                case "XL":
                                    $form.find('.size-name').html("Extra Large");
                                    break;
                            }
                            $form .find(".stl-product-add-to-cart").text("Add To Cart")
                            $form .find("input[name=id]").val($sizeToSelect.data("variant-id"))
                            $sizeToSelect.prop("checked", true)
                            $sizeToSelect.addClass("selected")

                            // update preorder ship text
                            $form.find(".preorder-ship").empty()
                            if(product.preorderShipDate !== ""){
                                $form.find(".preorder-ship").append("Shipping by <span>"+product.preorderShipDate+"</span>")
                                if(!$form.find("input[name='properties[Note]']").length){
                                    $form.prepend('<input type="hidden" id="preorderNote" name="properties[Note]" value="Preorder" data-role="none">')
                                }
                            } else{
                                if($form.find("input[name='properties[Note]']").length){
                                    $form.find("input[name='properties[Note]']").remove()
                                }
                            }

                            // update price change
                            $details.find(".price-wrapper").empty()
                            // format price
                            var formattedPrice = Shopify.formatMoney(product.price)
                            var formattedComparePrice = Shopify.formatMoney(product.comparePrice)
                            if(formattedPrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
                                formattedPrice = formattedPrice.substring(0,formattedPrice.indexOf("."));
                            }
                            if(formattedComparePrice.indexOf(".00") !== -1){
                                formattedComparePrice = formattedComparePrice.substring(0,formattedComparePrice.indexOf("."));
                            }
                            if(product.price < product.comparePrice){
                                $details.find(".price-wrapper").append("<h3 class='price compare'>"+formattedComparePrice+"</h3><h3 class='price sale'>"+formattedPrice+"</h3>")
                            } else{
                                $details.find(".price-wrapper").append("<h3 class='price'>"+formattedPrice+"</h3>")
                            }

                            // update color name on change
                            var $selectedColor = $swatchWrapper.find(".swatch-element.color input:checked")
                            $swatchWrapper.find("input.selected").removeClass("selected")
                            $selectedColor.addClass("selected")
                            $details.find(".color-name").text($selectedColor.data("color"))

                            // update text Final Sale disclaimer and hidden input
                            $details.find(".disclaimer").empty()
                            $form.find("input[name='properties[Final-Sale]']").remove();
                            $form.find("input[name='comparePrice']").val(product.comparePrice)
                            $form.find("input[name='price']").val(product.price)
                            if(product.price < product.comparePrice){
                                $details.find(".disclaimer").text("This item is final sale. No exchanges or returns.")
                                $form.prepend("<input type='hidden' name='properties[Final-Sale]' value='true'>")
                            }

                            // update promo text
                            // $item.find(".disclaimer").empty()
                            // if(product.tags.indexOf("SALE") !== -1 || product.tags.indexOf("sale") !== -1){
                            //     $item.find(".disclaimer").text("Save 20% with code FALL20")
                            // }
                        }
                    })
                }
            })
        })

        // const for bodyScrollLock functionality

        //show look clicked on from homepage
        $(".slider-product").click(function(e){
            e.stopPropagation()

            // open shop the look modal
            $(".stl-modal").toggleClass("active")
            // lock body scroll
            bodyScrollLock.disableBodyScroll(targetElement);
            // if modal open, show inner content
            if($(".stl-modal.active").length){
                var lookNumber = $(this).data("look")
                var productsToShow = [];
                var selectedLook;
                stlLooks.forEach(function(look){
                    if(look.lookNumber == lookNumber){
                        selectedLook = look;
                        look.mainProducts.forEach(function(mainProduct){
                            look.allProducts.forEach(function(product){
                                if(mainProduct.handle == product.handle){
                                    productsToShow.push(product)
                                }
                            })
                        })
                    }
                })
                $(".stl-products").empty()
                addProductsToSTLModal(productsToShow, selectedLook)
                // load other look grid images
                $(".stl-other-looks img").each(function(event){
                    var src, parentWidth, srcWidth;
                    var pixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio;
                    if(window.innerWidth > 799){
                        parentWidth = Math.round($(this).parent().width())
                        srcWidth = Math.round(parentWidth * pixelRatio)
                        src = Shopify.resizeImage($(this).data("src"), srcWidth+"x")
                        $(this).attr("src", src)
                    } else{
                        parentWidth = Math.round($(this).parent().width())
                        srcWidth = Math.round(parentWidth * pixelRatio)
                        src = Shopify.resizeImage($(this).data("mobile-src"), srcWidth+"x")
                        $(this).attr("src", src)
                    }
                })
                // hide grid image of selected look
                $(".stl-other-looks [data-look="+lookNumber+"]").addClass("active")
                // change main banner image
                var desktopBannerSrc = $(".stl-other-looks [data-look="+lookNumber+"]").data("banner")
                var mobileBannerSrc = $(".stl-other-looks [data-look="+lookNumber+"]").data("mobile-banner")
                if($(window).width() < 800){
                    $(".stl-main-image").attr("src", mobileBannerSrc)
                } else{
                    $(".stl-main-image").attr("src", desktopBannerSrc)
                }
                // remove loading screen
                $(".stl-modal__inner>div").css("opacity","0")
                setTimeout(function(){
                    $(".stl-modal__inner>div, .stl-product").animate({opacity: 1},500);
                },750)
                // Set next and previous looks
                lookNumber = parseInt(lookNumber)
                var nextLookNumber;
                var prevLookNumber;
                if(lookNumber == 1){
                    prevLookNumber = 10;
                    nextLookNumber = lookNumber + 1;
                } else if (lookNumber == 10){
                    prevLookNumber = lookNumber - 1;
                    nextLookNumber = 1;
                } else{
                    nextLookNumber = lookNumber + 1;
                    prevLookNumber = lookNumber - 1;
                }
                $(".current-look").text(lookNumber)
                $(".stl-navigation-next").data("look-to-show",nextLookNumber)
                $(".stl-navigation-prev").data("look-to-show",prevLookNumber)

                // send event to Lucky Orange
                window._loq.push(["tag", "Shop The Look "+lookNumber+" Click"]);
                // send event to Google Tag Manager
                dataLayer.push({
                    'event': 'promotionView',
                    'type': 'STL Click',
                    'ecommerce': {
                        'promoView': {
                            'promotions': [{
                                'name': "HP Shop The Look",
                                'creative': "Look "+lookNumber
                            }]
                        }
                    }
                })
            }
            // add padding if desktop nav is showing
            if ($(window).width() > 799) {
                $(".stl-modal").css("padding","70px 77px 0")
                // change horizontal alignment property if viewport height shorter than modal height
                setInterval(function(){
                    if($(".stl-modal__wrapper").height() > ($(window).height() - 70)) {
                        $(".stl-modal").css("align-items", "flex-start")
                    } else{
                        $(".stl-modal").css("align-items", "center")
                    }
                }, 500)
            }
        })
