        // Submission script for Homepage signup section
        var request;
        $(".email-capture form").submit(function(e){
            e.preventDefault();

            var $form = $(this);
            if($form.find(".checkbox-input-wrapper.terms input").is(":checked")){
                $("body").css("cursor", "progress");
                // Abort any pending request
                if (request) {
                    request.abort();
                }
                // Clear last message
                // Let's select and cache all the fields
                var $fullname = $form.find("input[type=text]");
                var fullname = $form.find("input[type=text]").val().trim();
                var $email = $form.find("input[type=email]");
                var email = $form.find("input[type=email]").val().trim();
                var url = $form.data("url")
                var $submitBtn = $form.find("button[type=submit]");

                // validate full name has been entered
                if(fullname.indexOf(' ') === -1){
                    $form.find($fullname).css({ 'border': '2px solid red' })
                    $form.find($fullname).val("")
                    $("body").css("cursor", "default");
                    return;
                } else{
                    fname = fullname.substr(0,fullname.indexOf(' '));
                    lname = fullname.substr(fullname.indexOf(' ')+1);
                    $form.find("input[name=fname]").val(fname);
                    $form.find("input[name=lname]").val(lname);
                }

                if ( validateEmail(email) ) {

                    dataLayer.push({ 
                        'event': 'signup',
                        'type':'Homepage'
                    })
                    // Serialize the data in the form
                    var serializedData = $form.serialize();
                    // Let's disable the inputs for the duration of the Ajax request.
                    // Note: we disable elements AFTER the form data has been serialized.
                    // Disabled form elements will not be serialized.
                    $email.prop("disabled", true);
                    $submitBtn.prop("disabled", true);
                    // Fire off the request to Google Sheet
                    request = $.ajax({
                        url: url,
                        type: "post",
                        data: serializedData
                    });
                    // Callback handler that will be called on success
                    request.done(function (response, textStatus, jqXHR){
                        // Thank user
                        $email.val('Thank you for joining the herd!');
                        window.liQ = window.liQ || [];
                        window.liQ.push({
                            "event": "conversion",
                            "name": "email_signup",
                            "email": email
                        });
                    });
                    // Callback handler that will be called on failure
                    request.fail(function (jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown){
                        // Log the error to the page
                        $email.val('There was an error. Please try again.');
                    });
                    // Callback handler that will be called regardless
                    // if the request failed or succeeded
                    request.always(function () {
                        // Reenable the inputs
                        $form.find("input[name=fname]").val(fname+" "+lname);
                        $email.prop("disabled", false);
                        $submitBtn.prop("disabled", false);
                        $("body").css("cursor", "default");
                    });
                }
            } else{
                $form.find(".checkbox-input-wrapper.terms").css({ 'border': '2px solid red', 'padding': '2px' })
            }
        });

        $(".wrapper form .checkbox-input-wrapper.terms input").click(function(){
          if($(this).is(':checked')){
            $("form .checkbox-input-wrapper.terms").css({ 'border': 'none', 'padding': '0' })
          }
        })
        $(".wrapper form input[type=text]").click(function(){
            $(this).css({ 'border': 'none' })
        })
    })

    $(document).ready(function(){

        // Lazy load images using IntersectionObserver
        let options = {
            root:null,
            rootMargin:'0px',
            threshold: 0.01
        }
        let imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver(lazyLoadImages, options)
        let images = document.querySelectorAll('.lazy-img');
        images.forEach(img => imageObserver.observe(img));

        let videoObserver = new IntersectionObserver(lazyLoadVideos, options)
        let videos = document.querySelectorAll('.lazy-video');
        videos.forEach(video => videoObserver.observe(video));

        if($(".cart-dropdown.items").length){ addPriceObjectsToLocalStorage() }

        // Show size options when add to cart button clicked for upsell item
        $(".cart-dropdown").on("click", ".upsell-item-cta",function(){
            $(this).addClass("active")
        })

        $(".cart-dropdown").on("click", ".upsell-item-cta+form button[type=submit]", function(e){
            $(document.body).css({'cursor' : 'wait'});
            e.preventDefault();
            var priceObject = {};
            priceObject['price'] = $(this).data("price");
            priceObject['comparePrice'] = $(this).data("compare-price");
            var variantId = this.value;
            var $form = $(this).closest('form');
            var upsellPromoName = $form.data('upsell-name')
            var $formData = $form.serialize();
            var $formDataArr = $form.serializeArray();
            $formData += "&id="+variantId;
            $formDataArr.push({name: "id", value: variantId})
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "/cart/add.js",
                data: $formData,
                dataType: "JSON",
                success: function(data) {
                    localStorage.setItem(variantId,JSON.stringify(priceObject))
                    // Push data to Data Layer
                    if(!$.cookie("upsellAdded")){
                        dataLayer.push({
                            'event': 'addToCart', // This value must not change
                            'type': 'Upsell Add',
                            'upsell':'Added',
                            'ecommerce': {
                                'promoClick': {
                                    'promotions': [{
                                        'name': "Upsell In Cart",
                                        'creative': upsellPromoName
                                    }]
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        $.cookie("upsellAdded", true)
                    }
                    // Update cart with new item
                    ajaxDropdownCartUpdate();
                },
                error: function(data){
                    $(document.body).css({'cursor' : 'auto'});
                    alert("No more inventory available!")
                }
            });
        })

        // open and close cart dropdown
        $("header #cartToggle,header .close,header .close-tr").click(function(){ toggleCart() })

        // Dropdown AJAX adjust quantity
        $(".cart-dropdown").on("click", ".qty_adjust", function () {
            var $button = $(this);
            var oldValue = $button.closest('.quantity').find("input.qty_input").val();
            var newVal = 0;
            var handle = $(this).closest('.quantity').find("input.qty_input").data('handle');
            var id = $(this).closest('.quantity').find("input.qty_input").data('id')
            if ($button.text() == "+") {
                // Disable buttons, Update Cart using AJAX, Reenable buttons
                newVal = parseInt(oldValue) + 1;
                Shopify.getProduct(handle,function(product){
                    // check if inventory is available for quanity increase
                    var inventoryAvail;
                    for(var i=0;i<product.variants.length;i++){
                        var variant = product.variants[i]
                        if(variant.id == id && (variant.inventory_quantity >= newVal || variant.inventory_policy == "continue")){
                            inventoryAvail = true;
                            $button.closest('.quantity').find(".loading-bars").addClass("active");
                        } else if(variant.id == id){
                            inventoryAvail = false;
                        }
                    }
                    if(inventoryAvail){
                        var name = product.title;
                        var price = Shopify.formatMoney(product.price);
                        dataLayer.push({
                            'event': 'addToCart', // This value must not change
                            'type': 'Quantity Adjust'
                        })
                        // LiveConnect Data
                        window.liQ = window.liQ || [];
                        window.liQ.push({
                            "event": "addToCart",
                            "name": "",
                            "email": "",
                            "items": [{
                                "id": id,
                                "price": price,
                                "quantity": 1,
                                "currency": "USD"
                            }]
                        });
                        Shopify.changeItem(id,newVal,function(cart){
                            setTimeout(function(){
                                ajaxUpdateLineItem(id, newVal, cart)
                            },500)
                        })
                    } else{
                        alert("No inventory available!")
                    }
                })
            } else if (oldValue > 1){
                $button.closest('.quantity').find(".loading-bars").addClass("active");
                // Disable buttons, Update Cart using AJAX, Reenable buttons
                newVal = parseInt(oldValue) - 1;
                Shopify.changeItem(id,newVal,function(cart){
                    setTimeout(function(){
                        ajaxUpdateLineItem(id, newVal, cart)
                    },500)
                })
            } else if (oldValue === 1){
                // do nothing
            }
        });

        var request;
        $("#footer-newsletter").submit(function(event){
            // Prevent default posting of form - put here to work in case of errors
            event.preventDefault();
            if($("#footer-newsletter .accept-terms input").is(":checked")){
                // Abort any pending request
                if (request) {
                    request.abort();
                }

                // setup some local variables
                var $form = $(this);
                var $email = $form.find("input[type=email]");
                var email = $email.val().trim()
                var $submitBtn = $form.find("input[type=submit]");

                // Clear last message
                $email.removeClass("submitted")

                var name = $form.find("input[name=fname]").val().trim();
                var fname, lname;
                if(name.indexOf(' ') === -1){
                    fname = name;
                    lname = ""
                } else{
                    fname = name.substr(0,name.indexOf(' '));
                    lname = name.substr(name.indexOf(' ')+1);
                }
                $form.find("input[name=fname]").val(fname);
                $form.find("input[name=lname]").val(lname);
                if (validateEmail(email)) {
                    // Serialize the data in the form
                    var serializedData = $form.serialize();
                    // Let's disable the inputs for the duration of the Ajax request.
                    // Note: we disable elements AFTER the form data has been serialized.
                    // Disabled form elements will not be serialized.
                    $email.prop("disabled", true);
                    $submitBtn.prop("disabled", true);
                    // Fire off the request to Google Sheet
                    request = $.ajax({
                        url: "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbya7-obSmjQWDzdTIuDMddyJkeF4JsgRee6gcwaYc5lqiIZPiOf/exec",
                        type: "post",
                        data: serializedData
                    });
                    // Callback handler that will be called on success
                    request.done(function (response, textStatus, jqXHR){
                        // Thank user and clear input field
                        $email.val('Thank you for joining the herd!');
                        $email.addClass("submitted")
                        dataLayer.push({
                            'event': 'signup',
                            'type': 'Footer'
                        })
                        window.liQ.push({
                            "event": "conversion",
                            "name": "email_signup",
                            "email": email
                        });
                    });
                    // Callback handler that will be called on failure
                    request.fail(function (jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown){
                        // Log the error to the page
                        $email.val('There was an error. Please try again.');
                    });
                    // Callback handler that will be called regardless
                    // if the request failed or succeeded
                    request.always(function () {
                        // Reenable the inputs
                        $form.find("input[name=fname]").val(fname+" "+lname);
                        $email.prop("disabled", false);
                        $submitBtn.prop("disabled", false);
                    });
                } else if (email !== '' && !validateEmail(email)) {
                    $email.val('Please enter a valid email address');
                } else {
                    $email.val('Please enter your email address');  
                }
            } else{
                $("#footer-newsletter .terms-container").css({
                    'border': '2px solid red',
                    'padding': '5px'
                })
            }
        });

        $("#footer-newsletter .accept-terms input").click(function(){
            if($("#footer-newsletter .accept-terms input").is(':checked')){

                    'border': 'none',
                    'padding': '0'

<script>
  $(document).ready(function(){
    var clickId = getUrlParam("clickId");
    var clickIdArray = $.cookie("pjClickIds")
    if(clickId && clickIdArray && clickIdArray.indexOf(clickId) === -1){
      clickIdArray = $.cookie("pjClickIds")+","+clickId;
      $.cookie("pjClickIds",clickIdArray,{ expires: 30 })
    } else if(clickId && !clickIdArray){
      $.cookie("pjClickIds",clickId,{ expires: 30 })
    }
  })
</script>

(function(){

function priceFromCents(cents) {
    if (typeof(cents) != "number")
        return;

    return (cents / 100);
}

function isRelevantCartUpdate(settings) {
    function dataContains(term) {
        return settings.data && settings.data.indexOf && settings.data.indexOf(term) > -1;
    }

    return (settings.url == "/cart/add.js" || settings.url == "/cart/update.js")
      && (
        dataContains('attributes[prod') ||
        (dataContains('id=') && dataContains('quantity='))
      );
}

$(document).ajaxSuccess(function(event, xhr, settings) {
    if (isRelevantCartUpdate(settings)) {
        $.getJSON("/cart.js", function(data) {
            var basketData = [];
            var item;

            if (!data.items || !data.items.length)
                return;

            for (var i = 0; i < data.items.length; i++) {
                item = data.items[i];

                basketData.push({
                    id: item.product_id,
                    price: priceFromCents(item.price),
                    quantity: item.quantity
                });
            }

            window.criteo_q.push({
                event: "viewBasket",
                product: basketData
            });
        });
    }
});
})();
